name: Hondou Ayano
source:
Daughter of the protagonist's landlord, the two of them are naturally friends with each other. 

Works part-time at her father's computer-store. She is very shy and as a result doesn't cope very well with sexual innuendo. She has a strong sense of justice but is unable to express herself much of the time. 

Secret identity of the hero known as "Maiden".
